finding.claim: Password reset token is compared with loose `==` in reset_password_loose(), enabling account takeover through type juggling. If $token arrives as a JSON boolean `true`, `'abc' == true` is true. If the stored token is a numeric-looking string such as '0e123…', any other '0e…' string compares equal. The strict sibling reset_password() at line 14 uses hash_equals with a (string) cast, which shows the intended control.
finding.source: $token and $email arguments of reset_password_loose(). The caller is not in the repo, so the attacker is assumed to be an unauthenticated user submitting the reset form or a JSON body. Type juggling needs a JSON-decoded non-string token, or a stored token with a '0e<digits>' form.
finding.sink: UPDATE users SET pw = ... WHERE email = ... at reset.php:5-6, which sets an attacker-chosen password for the victim email

trace.note: Token is fetched from resets by attacker-chosen email, which is correctly quoted
`$row['token'] == $token` is a loose comparison, not constant-time and not type-strict
Password is overwritten for that email with a hash of the attacker-supplied $new

finding.guards_checked: SQL injection: safe, because $db->quote() is applied to every interpolated value. Strict comparison: absent in this function; reset_password() at line 14 has it, but it is a separate function. Type casting: none on $token. Rate limiting, token expiry and single-use deletion: none visible in this file. The caller was not available, so which of the two functions is actually used is unverified.

verdict.guard_found: none in reset_password_loose (SQL values are quoted at reset.php:3,5,6, which blocks injection but not the comparison flaw); the strict hash_equals with a string cast exists only in the separate reset_password() at reset.php:14
verdict.reason: reset.php:4 does use a loose `==` with no cast, so a boolean `true` token would match any non-empty stored token, but grep finds no callers of either function, so I can't tell whether $token can ever be a non-string or whether the loose variant is reachable.
